title: Stretch or Grain, Sustain, and the Sample sheet
thisBuild: The Doctor is now the Sample sheet, with a new first page, Play. Open it with the Sample button beside the bank numbers on Pads (for the pad you last played), or hold a pad and pick Sample.

Pitch on the Play page: Stretch plays a pitch change like tape (higher is faster and shorter). Grain keeps the length. Auto, the default, keeps the length for keys, chords and Roll notes and lets the sound's own Tune stay tape.
So a long sound played up the keyboard now lasts as long at every key instead of shrinking at the top.
When it is held (moved here from Shape): Loop it, Hold the tail, Play once, plus two new ones.
Sustain: the sound plays its attack, then holds like a pad for as long as your finger (or Hold) keeps it, and fades when you let go.
On the beat: with Hold on, the sound plays whole and starts again every beat, every 2 beats or every bar, in time with the music.

Repeat styles, in the repeat rate menu under RPT: Cut each repeat (as before), Let repeats ring (each repeat plays out over the last), and Flow (hold the note and pulse its volume, good for pads and chords). The dock shows RNG or FLO when one is on.
watch: Play a long sound on Keys from low to high. In Auto it should keep its length; switch the pad to Stretch on the Play page and hear the old tape way.
Listen for a flutter or a soft chorus on Grain, mostly on very clean tones far from the root. Send a note naming the sound if it bothers you.
Set a pad to Sustain and hold it for a few seconds: it should keep going smoothly, then fade on release.
Turn Hold on with a pad set to On the beat: it should restart on each beat, and stop when you unlatch it.
Try Flow on a chord with Repeat on: the chord should hold and breathe with the repeat rate.
limits: Grain costs about three times the CPU of Stretch per voice. If you hear clicks with many held notes, switch those pads to Stretch and send a note. A bake option that does the work ahead of time is next.
Grain blurs very sharp hits a little (a drum played up the keys). Drums on pads are not affected: pads play at their own pitch.
The repeat style is for this session only, like the repeat rate. It is not saved in the mess yet.
Synths, loops and the RC-505 library are coming in later builds.
